description_en: Delete the mapping between users and groups for an Apsara File Storage for HDFS file system instance
description_zh: 删除文件存储 HDFS 版文件系统实例的用户和组的映射关系
kebab_example: aliyun dfs delete-user-groups-mapping --input-region-id cn-hangzhou --file-system-id 55C5FFD6-BF99-41BD-9C66-FFF391890000 --user-name user1 --group-names group1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteUserGroupsMapping

parameters.help_en: The region where the file system resides
parameters.name: input_region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Apsara File Storage for HDFS file system instance
parameters.help_zh: 文件存储 HDFS 版的文件系统实例ID
parameters.name: file_system_id

parameters.help_en:
Username. Constraints:

Must start with a letter or an underscore (_).

Length is 1 to 32 characters. Cannot be an empty string.

Supports lowercase English letters, numbers, and underscores (_).

Each user can belong to a maximum of 10 groups
parameters.help_zh:
用户名。
限制：

必须以字母或者下划线（_）开头。

长度为1~32个字符串，不能是空字符串。

支持小写英文字母、数字和下划线（_）。

每个用户最多属于10个组
parameters.name: user_name

parameters.help_en:
The names of the groups to which the username belongs. Constraints:

Must start with a letter or an underscore (_).

Length is 1 to 32 characters. Cannot be an empty string.

Supports lowercase English letters, numbers, and underscores (_)
parameters.help_zh:
用户名所属的组名。
限制：
必须以字母或者下划线（_）开头。

长度为1~32个字符串，不能是空字符串。

支持小写英文字母、数字和下划线（_）
parameters.name: group_names
